## Checklist
- [ ] I signed off every commit (`git commit -s`) — **DCO required**
- [ ] Tests added/updated (bug fixes include a regression test)
- [ ] CI is green (don't request review on red CI)
- [ ] Breaking changes are noted in the PR body and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] I read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/CitrateNetwork/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
      and, for a security-sensitive change, [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/CitrateNetwork/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
